_comment: A card that exists only for the opponent-chooser test (tests/unit/choices/test_opponent_chooser.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_rejoin` is Rejoin the Fight: each opponent picks a creature card in YOUR graveyard that nobody has picked yet, and all the picks come back together.

cards.name: Test Rejoin
cards.oracle_text: Each opponent chooses a creature card in your graveyard that hasn't been chosen. Return each card chosen this way to the battlefield under your control.
